business_problem: Miro helps distributed teams of all sizes collaborate and use the solution to lead engaging workshops and meetings, design products, brainstorm ideas, and more. “Miro is redefining how teams that bring new products and services to market can get projects from idea to launch, helping them unlock the huge potential of generative AI,” says Ayala Ohyon, head of data science at Miro.
solution_summary: Always striving to be on the cutting edge, Miro began to explore the potential of generative artificial intelligence (AI) to support its users. Miro Assist consists of a diverse set of AI features built on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Using services like Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), a managed service for running Kubernetes on AWS, Miro can quickly deploy and scale its AI features, relying on expert support and flexible security provisioning from AWS. “Miro is redefining how teams that bring new products and services to market can get projects from idea to launch, helping them unlock the huge potential of generative AI,” says Ayala Ohyon, head of data science at Miro.

solution_components.name: Amazon EKS
solution_components.role: Runs and scales Kubernetes-based application and analytics services.

solution_components.name: AWS IAM
solution_components.role: Controls identities, permissions, and secure access to cloud resources.

data_flow: “It’s very helpful to have direct contact with people at AWS who are fluent in the resources and can give advice and assurance that we’re maximizing the full potential of the current technology.” Using AWS, data is encrypted at rest and in transit, and access to data is controlled through AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM), which securely manages identities and access to AWS services and resources.
business_outcome: “By adopting a standardized approach built on AWS, we are empowered to rapidly create cutting-edge AI models and help Miro users benefit from the latest AI developments.” By adopting a standardized approach built on AWS, we are empowered to rapidly create cutting-edge AI models and help Miro users benefit from the latest AI developments.
architecture_clues: Using Amazon EKS, Miro can scale as needed to reduce overprovisioning while maintaining low latency, low error rates, and a stable solution.
evidence_quotes: Miro helps distributed teams of all sizes collaborate and use the solution to lead engaging workshops and meetings, design products, brainstorm ideas, and more.

“Miro is redefining how teams that bring new products and services to market can get projects from idea to launch, helping them unlock the huge potential of generative AI,” says Ayala Ohyon, head of data science at Miro.
Because of its successful history on AWS, Miro pursued using Amazon EKS for a consistent deployment process for generative AI models.
Miro developed an architecture to serve as a blueprint for setting up new AI microservices.
